## C2 PICO 筛选结果：二甲双胍 + 2 型糖尿病成人 + HbA1c

逐条审查 10 篇摘要：

| ID | 设计 | 干预/暴露 | 人群 | 结局含 HbA1c | 判定 |
|:---|:-----|:----------|:-----|:-------------|:-----|
| **S1** | RCT (2020) | Metformin vs placebo | T2DM adults | ✓ HbA1c | ✅ 符合 |
| S2 | RCT (2016) | Diet + exercise (非二甲双胍) | T2DM adults | fasting glucose (无 HbA1c) | ❌ 排除 |
| **S3** | cohort (2019) | Metformin adherence | T2DM adults | ✓ HbA1c | ✅ 符合 |
| S4 | RCT (2021) | SGLT2 inhibitor (非二甲双胍) | T2DM adults | HbA1c | ❌ 排除 |
| **S5** | RCT (2018) | Metformin ER | T2DM adults | ✓ HbA1c | ✅ 符合 |
| S6 | systematic review | — | — | — | ❌ 排除 (综述) |
| S7 | RCT (2022) | Digital coaching (非二甲双胍) | T2DM adults | HbA1c | ❌ 排除 |
| S8 | case report | — | — | — | ❌ 排除 (个案) |
| **S9** | RCT (2023) | Metformin + GLP-1 RA | T2DM adults | ✓ HbA1c | ✅ 符合 |
| **S10** | RCT (2017) | Metformin dose comparison | T2DM adults | ✓ HbA1c | ✅ 符合 |

---

答案: S1, S3, S5, S9, S10
